name: Breach Candy Hospital
description: BCH offers comprehensive clinical services under one roof with an active Transplant Program. The hospital provides round the clock network of Emergency services , Diagnostic services, a Blood Bank facility and a Pharmacy supported by a team of expert senior clinical consultants working in a full-time capacity. The active association with over 150 clinical consultants adds a unique strength to BAGH and enables us to achieve the highest outcomes for our patients capacity.
